idea.problem: Correctly implement copy assignment for a type that registers itself, by its own address, as an observer/auditor on external containers reachable from its current state (like SoPath registering itself on each node's SoChildList so scene-graph edits notify it), so that assigning a new route unregisters the old observation exactly once, registers the new one exactly once, and self-assignment is a safe no-op.
capabilities: explicitly unregister an object's own address from every external observer list it is currently registered on before adopting new state
guard copy assignment against self-assignment before mutating any state
document assignment as intentionally leaving container/observer membership untouched, deferring identity transfer to an explicit swap
use the copy-and-swap idiom so the old state's own destructor performs cleanup
constraints: C++11 as the minimum supported language standard
must not leave a stale pointer registered on any external list after assignment
non_goals: changing the meaning of copy construction
